responsibility: This implementation module realizes the Logitech-compatible display backend used by the terminal stack. It writes characters to FIO.StdOut, translating ASCII.EOL to the library newline character and implementing ASCII.del as a backspace-space-backspace erase sequence, so higher-level terminal modules can rely on legacy character-display behavior.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Display pair: it maps EOL and delete characters to concrete FIO.StdOut write sequences, whereas Display.def only specifies the exported Write procedure.
